title: Hearty Buttery Syrian Rice Pilaf
description: A quick-fix Syrian dish featuring raisins and a dairy-free friendly kombu cold extract, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is buttery, crisp, and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the unsalted vegan butter and let it melt, stirring occasionally.
Add the rinsed and drained rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice with the butter and oil mixture.
Add the water, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, stir in the raisins and kombu cold extract.
Continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 5 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
